description: Open the read-a-thon fundraiser spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/ReadAthon_Data.xlsx. The spreadsheet contains messy pledge data with two types: 'Per Book' (multiply pledge amount by books read) and 'Flat' (one-time amount). Add an 'Amount Owed' column (Column H) with formulas to calculate what each sponsor owes based on their pledge type. Handle blank/zero books read. Create a summary section showing Total Pledged, Total Collected (status='Paid'), and Total Outstanding. Optionally create collection letters in /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/Collection_Letters.docx for unpaid sponsors. Save all files (Ctrl+S).
